nodes.title: Models · Hugging Face downloads
widgets_values:
## Models – official Hugging Face downloads

Manual download: put each file into the folder shown.

**ComfyUI/models/diffusion_models**
- [trellis_2_int8_convrot.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/TRELLIS.2/resolve/main/diffusion_models/trellis_2_int8_convrot.safetensors) – Trellis.2
- [Hi3D_v1.0_transformer_512.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/hi3d-official/Hi3Dv1.0/resolve/main/transformer_512/model.safetensors) – Hi3D 512 pass *(save as `Hi3D_v1.0_transformer_512.safetensors`)*
- [Hi3D_v1.0_transformer_1024.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/hi3d-official/Hi3Dv1.0/resolve/main/transformer_1024/model.safetensors) – Hi3D 1024/1536 detail pass *(save as `Hi3D_v1.0_transformer_1024.safetensors`)*

**ComfyUI/models/vae**
- [trellis_2_shape_vae_bf16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Pixal3D/resolve/main/vae/trellis_2_shape_vae_bf16.safetensors)
- [trellis_2_texture_vae_bf16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Pixal3D/resolve/main/vae/trellis_2_texture_vae_bf16.safetensors)
- [Hi3D_v1.0_vae.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/hi3d-official/Hi3Dv1.0/resolve/main/vae/model.safetensors) – Hi3D Sparse VAE *(save as `Hi3D_v1.0_vae.safetensors`)*

**ComfyUI/models/clip_vision**
- [dino_v3_L_naf_fp32.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Pixal3D/resolve/main/clip_vision/dino_v3_L_naf_fp32.safetensors)

**ComfyUI/models/background_removal**
- [birefnet.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/BiRefNet/resolve/main/background_removal/birefnet.safetensors)

## Model pages
- ComfyUI files: [Comfy-Org/TRELLIS.2](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/TRELLIS.2) · [Comfy-Org/BiRefNet](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/BiRefNet)
- Original models: [TRELLIS.2 by Microsoft](https://huggingface.co/microsoft/TRELLIS.2-4B) · [Hi3Dv1.0 by OCEANO HK](https://huggingface.co/hi3d-official/Hi3Dv1.0)
